content: The notice board is at (3,7). I'll read it, then till/plant/water a few plots in the meadow (open soil at y=5–6), and wait out the days until the pass opens on day 5, ending near the pass entrance at (11,4)-adjacent tile (11,3) so we're ready to walk north.

args.approach: Pass is blocked until day 5 (wiki + notice board); so read the notice, farm the meadow soil to pass time productively, then wait near the pass entrance ready to go north on day 5.
